name: Installation scheduling support
short: Organize approved installation dates, access notes, and preparation records for your installation manager.
tasks: Confirm customer access and preparation instructions
Track materials-ready status supplied by your team
Record schedule changes and unresolved dependencies
heroAlt: Field professional reviewing a clipboard at a work site

roleFit: HVAC businesses with a named installation or service-agreement owner and documented administrative procedures.
Start with one service area or agreement type where the inputs and review standard are clear.
problem: An installation can be delayed when access instructions, material updates, and customer availability live in separate messages. The support desk keeps those administrative dependencies together.
inputsAccess: Provide the approved checklist, customer record, calendar or agreement repository, and named escalation owner.
Use role-based access and written limits for changes, communications, and record retention.
workflowSteps: Confirm customer access and preparation instructions
Track materials-ready status supplied by your team
Record schedule changes and unresolved dependencies
Finish the shift with a dated handoff identifying open questions and the next owner.
deliverables: A current record with source dates, approved changes, and missing items visible.
A manager handoff covering pending customer requests, dependencies, and decisions.
qualityControls: Confirm customer, job or agreement identifier, source version, and approved dates before updating the record.
Review a sample against the source and investigate repeated missing fields rather than guessing.
exceptionPaths: Escalate conflicting dates, unclear scope, missing approvals, customer complaints, and requests outside the written rules.
Urgent safety reports follow the company emergency procedure and never wait in a routine administration queue.
decisionBoundaries: Technical scope, installation design, safety, coverage interpretation, price, payment, contracts, and customer commitments remain with qualified or authorized staff.
The assistant prepares records and approved communications; they do not approve exceptions or direct field work.
startingScenarios: A customer changes the available access window. The assistant records the request and asks the installation manager to approve the revised schedule before confirming it.
Begin with a small documented queue and manager review of each completed handoff. Expand only after the source and completion criteria are reliable.

faqs.q: Can the assistant change an installation date or agreement?
faqs.a: Only an explicitly permitted administrative change may be made under written instructions. Capacity, commercial terms, scope, and exceptions require the authorized manager.
No. Diagnosis, equipment selection, installation methods, safety advice, and technical approvals stay with qualified HVAC staff.
A dated record of completed work, source references, missing items, and customer questions that need a decision.

name: Service agreement administration
short: Keep agreement records, approved document versions, and customer handoffs organized.
tasks: Index signed agreements supplied by authorized staff
Check administrative fields against the approved checklist
Track missing signatures and document versions
Route scope and coverage questions to the agreement owner
